title: Coder agent output
description: Structured Rust patch emitted by the Coder agent given an Architect's architect_output.json input.  v0.4 replaces the v0.3 3-section markdown (## Patch / ## Test coverage / ## Notes) with this JSON shape.  The parser-converter subsection optionally uses the W21 Mon `propose_block_converter` tool call (Decision 46.7) for guaranteed-shape-correct rendering.

ast_struct_rust.description: Free-text Rust for the AST struct + Project field + serde attributes.  See knowledge/01_ast_struct_conventions.md for the canonical shape.

parser_converter.description: Either a tool-call spec (W21 Mon Decision 46.7 — preferred, runtime renders the Rust) OR free-text Rust (legacy / fallback).  Exactly one of the two variants must be populated.

checker_rust.description: Free-text Rust for the `validate_<block>s` fn + `Project::validate` dispatch hook.  See knowledge/03_checker_invariants.md.

test_fixtures_rust.description: Free-text Rust for the parser_fixtures.rs tests + any new `tests/data/<block>_block.{ais,json}` fixture pair content.  Each rejection test asserts on `ValidateError::Parse(errs)` substring (NOT a fictional `ParseError::X` variant).

covers_field.description: Field name from the Architect's `fields[]` array that this test exercises; or `(all)` for whole-block tests like duplicate-label / byte-stable round-trip.

new_refkind_variant.description: The new `RefKind::X` variant if added; null otherwise.  Mirrors Architect's `decision_implications.new_refkind`.

files_edited_beyond_four.description: Any file path edited outside the canonical four (ast.rs / parser.rs / checker.rs / parser_fixtures.rs).  Empty array when the patch fits within the four.

tool_call.description: Args for `aislang_runtime::codegen::render_block_converter`.  Schema mirrors `BlockConverterSpec` verbatim.  See knowledge/05_propose_block_converter_tool.md.

raw_rust.description: Free-text Rust for the `to_<block>` converter fn.  Must NOT use `hcl::*` types or invent `ParseError::X` variants.  Reviewer's negative-shape gate enforces this — see code_reviewer/knowledge/01_review_checklist.md.
